description: Search the adopted budget's Terms and Conditions (the conditions the Council attaches to agencies' appropriations, with the reports they require), FY2018 and FY2021–FY2027, from the checked tables BetaNYC reads from the PDFs. Each item gives its number in the book, pages, agency, units of appropriation, budget lines, report deadlines and the condition's text as printed, with its status label, flags, review decision where decided, and three links. Filter by fiscal_year, agency (name or code, substring), unit (a unit of appropriation as printed, e.g. '001', or the start of a budget line), text (substring of the condition or its heading). The same filters as the explorer's Terms view. Needs the optional PDF tables download. Text filters ignore case and accents; a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words only ('AI' finds 'AI-powered', not 'AIDS'), a longer one matches anywhere; whole_word true or false overrides that.

agency.description: Agency name or code (substring), e.g. 'Correction' or '072'

limit.description: Max items shown, 1–100 (default 20). Counts always cover every match.

text.description: Words in the condition's text or heading (substring)

unit.description: Unit of appropriation as printed ('001', 'All'), or the start of a budget line ('HD-0009')

whole_word.description: Sets how name and prose filters match: true, whole words only ('AI' not in 'Jamaica', 'Fellow' not in 'Fellowship'); false, anywhere ('AI' in 'AIDS'). Omit for the default: a term of 3 or fewer letters and digits matches whole words, a longer one anywhere.

name: search_terms_conditions
title: Search Terms and Conditions
